name: K. Wah International Holdings Limited
summary: K. Wah International Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and investment businesses in Hong Kong and Mainland China. The company's property portfolio, including residential developments, hotels, serviced apartments, and retail premises. It also offers property management services to residential buildings, commercial facilities, office towers, and real estate complexes. In addition, the company provides financial, management, and decoration services. K. Wah International Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in North Point, Hong Kong.
